works.title: Local AI First Boot Framework and Implementation Book
works.description: A book documenting the development and implementation of a framework for setting up local AI systems on personal computers. The work synthesizes 18 months of conceptual AI collaboration into a 3-month execution phase, incorporating personal experiences and lessons learned into a guide for readers. Includes practical setup procedures, hardware evaluation, model selection and deployment, and system architecture decisions.
works.quote: I'm thinking occasional personal references are appropriate—they don't consume much text, they ground the book in personal experience for readers, and they create a sense of shared discovery.

works.title: Methodological Note Template Library for Economic Reporting
works.description: A reference library of standard methodological notes for Main Street Independent's economic reporting. Covers routine economic stories including monthly jobs reports, quarterly GDP releases, CPI releases, Federal Reserve decisions, distributional policy analysis, corporate earnings, and other economic data releases. Provides guidance on when to expand methodology notes and how to acknowledge contested but legitimate methodological alternatives.
works.quote: Produce a reference library of standard methodological notes for routine economic stories. For each common story type — monthly jobs report, quarterly GDP release, CPI release, Federal Reserve rate decision, distributional analysis of legislation...

works.title: Soul Framework Specification
works.description: A comprehensive framework specification for narrative and character development, likely for fiction writing. Centers on character coalition structures, decision-making architectures reflecting universal human patterns, and fiction-writing machinery. The work establishes 'SoulSpec' as a standard specification format with systematic layers for implementing character agency and narrative choice architecture.
